Ji Min Ahn I think there is a fairly realistic chance they will give you an intervisa - though you can never be sure. They may ask you why you want one, and saying that you haven't been home to Korea for a long time/you need to visit your family is perfectly valid. Try and ask for multiple entries if you can (to give you more flexibility). Also you can see if they can give you an appointment - it doesn't hurt to try and pressure this. 

In any case, if I were in your position it would make more sense to attend this meeting and see what happens, and then make your decision from there, rather than cancelling and per-determining things :)
